description:
## Return YouTube Username+ v2.4

- Morphe v2.4.0+ Coexistence: Renamed to `Return YouTube Username+` with isolated `morphe_ryu_*` preference/setting keys and updated Morphe v2.3.0+/v2.4.0 preference components for conflict-free coexistence alongside official Morphe patches.
- InnerTube API & 7-Day Bounded Cache: Fast zero-config handle resolution via InnerTube API (with optional YouTube Data API v3 key & public page fallback), backed by a bounded LRU memory cache and 7-day TTL disk cache.
- Zero-Blocking Relayout: Integrates with `LithoRelayoutPatch` so comments, Shorts, video subtitles, and feed cards render immediately without UI stalls and update automatically once resolved.
- Display Format Picker: Built-in localized format selector (`Channel name`, `Channel name (@handle)`, `@handle (Channel name)`).
- Full Surface Support: Restores `@handles` across Comments, Shorts, Video Subtitles & Feed Cards, Live Chat & Super Chats, and Video Titles & Descriptions, while preserving `@handles` on channel profile headers and preview cards.
- Tested & Verified: Verified on YouTube v21.30.216, Morphe Manager v2.8.0, and Morphe Patches v2.4.0+.
